inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text:
The R20.56 million allegation deserves a serious investigation, but it is not proof that Terry Pheto did anything wrong. The bigger question is whether the National Lotteries Commission has strong enough systems to protect public money and ensure it reaches the communities it is supposed to serve. When public resources are at stake, focusing only on one individual can let institutional failures and weak oversight off the hook—while communities that depend on those resources are left waiting for answers.

At the briefing to Parliament’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, the demand should be clear: explain how these systems work, where they failed, and who was responsible. The SIU must establish what happened. Communities need transparency and accountability, not empty assurances.
